scope: Independent actual-pixel appearance review of final STL five rendered views; not engineering restoration, dimensional survey, structural safety or printability certification.
source_version: 2019-renovated open-lattice pavilions, cross-checked against official 2020 caption, EXIF-2023 and EXIF-2025 photos. 1998 solid-roof image used only as historical contrast. NLSC2024 watermark not asserted to be capture year.
source_integrity_note: The official partial-diagnostic PNG derives from a truncated JPEG; only its valid bridge pixels were used, not its gray missing-water area. Other listed images and two WMTS tiles are complete private source artifacts.

view_findings.front: Three separate routes, four open pavilions, near and far arched footways and flat central road visible. Corrected short gray stems no longer obscure the gold support profile; gold curls/curved shoulders now dominate the upper support zone.
view_findings.rear: Opposite rendered side retains all four corner pavilions, central flat road, separate pedestrian rails and bridge-underpass negative space; paired support arrangement is explicitly approximate, not a source-count claim.
view_findings.elevation: Central roadway stays flat behind the curved footway. Six near-side gold support stations and the gray exterior arch band are preserved. Gold width-direction curves project narrowly here as expected; no generic full-height gray posts remain.
view_findings.top: Two narrow independent wooden routes flank a distinct broad flat road, with inner rails separating them; four roofs terminate the two footways at both banks. Roof grids remain open rather than solid.
view_findings.left_oblique: Cross-width y-z curvature and lower rolled ends are visible, not longitudinal decorative scrolls. Four-column lattice cages, stepped open four-slope roof grids, irregularized stone-faced short approaches, and open bridge underside are legible.

previous_required_change_resolved: Original 34b456... candidate had full-height gray posts visually covering the golden corbels. Final aba427... shortens gray supports to the lower curl area, restores golden curved main supports and replaces regular rectangular brick appearance with irregularized stone relief.
accepted_approximations: All dimensions, bridge/road width proportions, arch rise, pavilion proportions and local curvature are estimated, not surveyed.
Far-side bracket count and fine profile are mirrored approximations; six clear near-side stations are evidenced, not every hidden member.
Hidden internal ribs, vehicle-bridge underside details and unseen crossbeam counts are intentionally not claimed or reconstructed.
Lattice/baluster/stone-joint counts, end-platform minor panels and detailed connections are simplified; open main topology is retained.
Only short bridge approaches and abutments are modeled; cut ends and display base do not assert a full lakeshore survey.
separate_qa_required: Mesh topology, slicer failures/thin-tip/overhang support needs, independent rebuild, scene edit/reopen and exchange validation remain separate checks and must bind to this final hash. This appearance PASS does not waive failures or certify support-free printing.
reopen_qa_note: Read final builder QA and verified its front hash matches independently reviewed PNG; reviewer did not personally rerun Blender reopen.
